brand.name: Live Model Test
brand.tagline: Model tests, live exams and results — in Bangla and English.

app.soonBody: The Live Model Test app will be on Google Play soon. Exams are taken in the app.

meta.homeTitle: Live Model Test — online model tests and live exams
meta.homeDescription: Practice model tests, take live exams on time, see your result and merit position — in Bangla and English. Download the Live Model Test app.

hero.eyebrow: Model tests · Live exams · Merit lists
hero.title: Prepare smarter with real exam practice
hero.body: Take timed model tests and live exams on your phone, see your marks the moment results are out, and know your merit position.

items.title: Live and practice exams
items.body: Scheduled live exams for everyone at once, and practice sets you can retake.

items.title: Fair, exact timing
items.body: The timer follows the server's clock, answers save as you go and the exam submits on time.

items.title: Results and merit lists
items.body: Marks, percentage and pass status, then your position on the merit list.

items.title: Answer review
items.body: See the correct answers and explanations when the exam allows review.

items.title: বাংলা and English
items.body: The app and many exams in both languages — switch any time.

items.title: Secure payments
items.body: Buy packages through trusted payment providers, verified by our server.

exams.title: Exams
exams.empty: New exams will appear here soon.

packages.title: Packages
packages.body: Free exams are open to everyone. Packages unlock paid exams.

steps.title: Download the app
steps.body: Install Live Model Test and sign up with your mobile number.

steps.title: Choose an exam
steps.body: Pick a live exam, a model test or a practice set.

steps.title: Get your result and rank
steps.body: See your marks, review answers and check the merit list.

final.title: Ready for your next exam?
final.body: Download the app and start practising today.
